name: Crash
description: Crash is a British partition card game (13-card Brag) in which players divide a 13-card hand into 3-card Brag hands and compare corresponding hands for points. The game originated in Britain and is played across northern England, Wales, and Scotland.

content.text: Crash is a British partition card game (13-card Brag) in which players divide a 13-card hand into 3-card Brag hands and compare corresponding hands for points. The game originated in Britain and is played across northern England, Wales, and Scotland.

Country/Region of Origin: United Kingdom (Britain). Played in northern England, Wales, and Scotland (e.g. Coventry to Cumbria and Yorkshire, Welshpool, South Wales, Plymouth, Edinburgh as Crackers).
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: British game; evolved from Three Card Brag; partition game for four or fewer players.
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game in pubs and homes across Britain.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included
